title: Performance measurement baseline and top bottlenecks
rawUserRequest: Implement the performance-first Work Item plan in English low-token mode, starting with an evidence-backed baseline and top bottleneck report.

declaredIntent.summary: Measure Work Item governance cost and explain the top three observed bottlenecks without changing gate decisions.

outOfScope: Task scheduling, agent assignment, and external orchestration.
Changing governance decisions based on measured cost.
Provider token estimates when exact values are unavailable.

sources.reason: Existing structured lifecycle and gate timing events.
Work Item-local lifecycle facts and read-only status.

riskAssessment.reason: Measurement must remain evidence-only and must not alter governance outcomes.

reasons: Performance measurement is a non-authoritative observability change.

executionDecision.reason: Evidence-only metrics are within the Work Item scope.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A Work Item metrics report records elapsed, phase, gate, retry, backtrack, and human-decision facts without estimates.
Unknown provider token and wait values remain explicitly unknown.
The report identifies the top three measured bottlenecks deterministically.
Metrics are advisory and cannot change a gate result.
Focused tests cover empty, malformed, mixed, and multi-run observability logs.
guidelines: Keep metrics evidence-only; never use it to bypass a required check.
Use exact observed durations and represent unavailable values as unknown.
Document the machine-readable schema and human-readable bottleneck output.

intent.problem: Current governance timing exists in several local receipts, but there is no Work Item-level baseline that explains where execution time and retries are spent.
constraints: Do not infer provider or human wait time from local elapsed time.
Do not change gate eligibility based on metrics.
Keep the report repository-local and free of credentials or sensitive values.
intent.rationale: A deterministic baseline is required before optimizing verification or enabling controlled parallel Work Items.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A complete observability log contains lifecycle and gate timings.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report preserves observed durations and ranks bottlenecks.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused unit test with deterministic event fixtures.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Provider or human wait data is absent.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Unavailable values remain unknown rather than estimated.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused unit test with no wait events.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A malformed or cross-Work-Item event is present.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report rejects the record or excludes it fail-closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused validation test for malformed JSON and identity mismatch.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
